commit.message:
fix(sim): judge spindle-C moves at the station pose and fixed steel in the machine frame

Reproduced first: on main the box fixture laws missed real hits under
the spindle C. Fixed steel was read in the part frame (the machine-frame
sweep cannot stand a radial pose upright about a vertical line, so the
part-frame verdict stood), so steel at the live-tool station was seen
only near C 0 - a generated Rotary Contour on a mill-turn C passed a
fixed steady at the station silent on the far side of the bar. Steel
riding the part was read at the whole move's pose, because cl::stamp_c
gave every piece the move's end axis.

- cl::stamp_c: each piece states the station pose at its own C (the
  move's axis turned by the turn left; the last piece bit-identical).
  The post writes C only, so the stream and goldens are unchanged.
- sim::verify::c_steel (new): the workholding laws read a C move's pose
  from its C (also keeps pre-fix cached paths honest), and read fixed
  steel in the machine frame too - the tip straight on the station ray,
  pose +X - adding hits to the part-frame verdict, never removing one.
  The spindle line is recovered from the stamped tips, else the op's
  axis, and used only when every tip agrees; otherwise a C move against
  fixed steel fails closed.

Pinned by crates/sim/tests/c_axis_fixture.rs and
crates/app/tests/c_axis_fixture.rs (both fail on main). No existing
verdict changed.

Fixes #486
